title: T-1789 partial: looser 1812 linen trouser seat (native build pending)
body:
The 1812 settler’s linen trousers currently follow the buttocks too tightly and show a deep rear crease. This partial T-1789 change gives the seat more room while preserving the body, rig, clothing colors and idle/walk clips.

Current delivery status:

- Corrected source `c9990d8b32517612a94e339a98bd5700436b5689` is committed, pushed and remotely verified. It normally integrates current DEV `900d9166e` and preserves the already-folded changelog history.
- All 16 source-check partitions passed this exact tree: 1,337 executions, original limits, accepted resource guards and complete cleanup. Both committed-head preflight questions passed against fresh DEV.
- Baseline observation is complete: four LODs, desktop and phone viewports, idle and eight walking phases, 104 images. These are BEFORE images; native garment-fit acceptance is still pending.
- First capture43000644195 passed its human/actor prerequisites, then stopped before geometry because a guard expected `Blender 4.5.3` instead of the checksum-verified release’s `Blender 4.5.3 LTS` header. That failure is preserved. The corrected exact-LTS guard retains all archive, binary and codec pins and adds wrong-version/archive-corruption controls.
- The observer now writes compact JSON with identical parsed values and unchanged byte limits. Its complete baseline capture passed with all fields retained.
- Fresh canonical build [43018920928](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/43018920928) is registered for this corrected source/definition and reviewed request `a0ec4b8f47218a9b3e72f1939a84c78960637e70c8f3fb9c2a90148f97bef761`. It is a new source-bound run, not a rerun of the original failure.

Remaining: inspect the actual new canonical parents against the saved cameras while standing/walking at all LODs, legitimately remeasure the eight-file native fixture, complete published validation and current-head CI, then merge into DEV when green. No new models have been adopted yet. This PR remains draft; broader T-1789 clothing fit and photographic acceptance remain open. Production is unchanged.
